text:
sarah: Heads-up, production token/sec dropped ~30% after the v3.8.1 merge this morning. Rolling 95th latency up too.
miguel: ugh, noticed traces too. Any obvious correlation with kernel selection or batching changes?
sarah: landing PR was #4321 — changed scheduler prefetch heuristic + kernel pinning tweak.
tanvi: linking perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/2045 — token/sec graph and alloc heatmap. :eyes:
miguel: can you paste the top-line numbers?
sarah: from 11:12UTC: tokens/s went 145k -> 100k across dedicated pool-a. KV hitrate down ~6%.
alex: canary started at 10:50, full rollout at 11:05. rollback window still open?
sarah: rollback blocked by canary gate because error rates stable, so rollout auto-continued. we should hold.
ci-bot: perf-check: v3.8.1 post-merge perf tests FAILED (token/sec regression > 20%). See: https://ci.redwood.internal/Build/9876
miguel: ok run a bisect on merge commits between 10:30–11:05. suspect the kernel pinning switch.
tanvi: started local bisect: narrowing to two commits. hypothesis: commit 6f1a2 changed kernel selection order for short-seq batches.
sarah: I replayed traffic with kernel hints off, tokens/sec returns to baseline.
miguel: paste the replay command?
sarah: ```bash
replay-traffic --from=10:30 --to=11:10 --env=prod --override 'runtime.kernel_pin=false' --metrics
```
tanvi: digging into KV cache traces: prefetch window change increased cache churn. small batches now evict older prefixes faster.
alex: that would explain hitrate loss and longer decode times.
miguel: any signs of continuous-batcher queueing delays?
sarah: yes, queue depth histogram shows more 200–400ms queued spikes after the heuristic change. serializing kernel switch per-batch adds overhead.
tanvi: committing a hotfix to revert the kernel-order change in #4336 (WIP).
miguel: nice. can we throttle the rollout and force a canary hold until we validate?
sarah: setting canary to manual and pausing rollout now.
dev-bot: Rollout paused for v3.8.1 at 11:55 UTC by sarah.
ci-bot: perf-check (hotfix #4336) queued.
tanvi: preliminary local numbers with revert: tokens/s back within 98% of baseline, KV hitrate recovered ~5.8%.
alex: plan: merge hotfix to canary, run 30min soak with perf-checks, then promote if green. create rollback playbook?
miguel: +1. assign owners and TLDR in the incident doc.
sarah: created incident doc: https://wiki.redwood.internal/incidents/2026-kernel-prefetch-regression. added logs, bisect notes, and commands.
tanvi: filing follow-up to improve test coverage for kernel ordering permutations and KV churn sim in CI.
sarah: thanks team — keeping the rollout paused until the canary soak finishes and perf-check is green. :thumbsup:
